title: Dynamic Block-Online Streaming ASR for Low-Resource Agglutinative Code-Switching Speech with Morphology-Aware Evaluation
description:
Code and resources for the Interspeech 2026 oral paper. Contains the reference implementation of Fine-Grained CS-WER (E_switch / E_root / E_morph), a morphology-aware evaluation metric for Bangla-English intra-sentential code-switching, and the 737-entry loanword lexicon used for Script-Anchored Loanword Injection.

Training and finetuning use FunASR upstream; this repository does not vendor a copy of it.
